faq.question: What does Sri mean?
faq.answer: Sri is associated with the Sanskrit form سْرِي, whose core sense is sri; prosperity, radiance (sanskrit).

faq.question: What is the origin of Sri?
faq.answer: Sri is associated with Sanskrit. Sri is Sanskrit श्री (śrī), meaning 'prosperity, radiance'. It is used as a female given name in Indonesia and South Asia.

faq.question: Is Sri an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Sri an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Sri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Sri a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Sri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Śrī is a Sanskrit word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Sri, sri. Script forms are سري, سری, سْرِي, श्री.
